pr_title: registry: Fix panic when server is unreachable
pr_body:
Non-HTTP errors previously resulted in a panic due to dereferencing the `resp` pointer while it was `nil`, as part of rendering the error message. This commit changes the error message formatting to cope with a `nil` response, and extends test coverage.

Fixes #24384

### Expected Behavior
Initialize the AWS provider and check/fetch latest provider plugin version. 

### Actual Behavior
While initalizing the provider plugin, terraform encountered a nill pointer dereference or invalid memory address.

### Steps to Reproduce
1. `terraform init`

### Additional Context
Running on Mac OS X from the command line via zsh. On the second attempt, it worked as expected and I have been unable to reproduce the crash.
### References
comments:
This is related to the [registry downtime](https://status.hashicorp.com/incidents/j9fwdnjt0m8t) we experienced. The caching of the init data was not behaving as expected either. 

This definitely should not panic if the registry is down or unreachable, but this area of the code is being reworked currently, going to leave these issue open to test the new code paths for this type of error once that work is complete.
/cc @findkim. This is coming form the retry code in the client.
